summary: Elong Power Holding Ltd. filed a 6-K disclosing a November 5, 2026 inducement offer letter with existing warrant holders covering May, July and August 2026 warrants (aggregate 3,193,862 Class A ordinary shares) at a $3.80 exercise price. Holders agreed to partially exercise for 1,808,803 shares while the company cut the exercise price of all existing warrants to $1.80 and issued new three-year warrants for 2,713,204 shares at $2.50 in a Section 4(a)(2) private placement, with full-ratchet anti-dilution reset mechanics. Watch overhang and dilution.
